name: What is the difference between a renovation, a remodel, and an addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a renovation, a remodel, and an addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A renovation typically involves updating the aesthetics of a space without changing its structure, such as painting or replacing fixtures. A remodel involves more significant changes, often altering the layout or function of a room, like reconfiguring a kitchen. An addition expands the footprint of your home by building new space, such as adding a new wing or a second story. Opus Builders handles all three, tailoring the project to your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation updates aesthetics, remodel changes layout/function, and an addition expands the home's footprint.
